source: latest user clarification: vision and touch operate in parallel; no absolute hierarchy
online_evidence: causal synchronized RGB and visual history
teacher_requirements: Use available evidence from both modalities throughout the action; no mandatory vision-first then touch sequence.
Lost red pixels alone must not mandate lifting/re-observation.
Neither visual uncertainty nor balanced fingertip force alone determines every action; evaluate combined evidence and uncertainty.
Tactile-supported correction need not universally await a verified visual tracker; object-motion estimates still require validation.
Preserve meaningful observe/hold/stop alternatives when evidence warrants them.
Current push policy must not retreat/lift/re-observe/return for perception; fixed-camera RGB continues. Evidence-insufficient stop is valid. Final withdrawal is not a re-observation action.
coverage: vision occluded or ambiguous with informative tactile evidence
tactile ambiguous with informative visual evidence
truth_usage: offline evaluation/labels only, never online teacher input

repair_scope.push_v5_to_v9: legacy engineering comparison; not repaired by relabeling
repair_scope.v10_infrastructure: retain snapshots; replace unconditional recovery prohibition when implementing actual fused policy
repair_scope.other_task_candidates: review for fixed modality hierarchy before rollout/admission
repair_scope.existing_grasp50: no automatic invalidation or training interruption; audit separately, no assertion of tactile causal benefit

contact_phase_requirements.initial_touch: single-finger contact may be a normal transient; not an automatic failure
contact_phase_requirements.contact_establishment: bounded evidence-supported alignment with force/collision limits; timeout and unknown retained
contact_phase_requirements.sustained_pushing: verify simultaneous two-finger contact before continuous advance; monitor loss/imbalance
contact_phase_requirements.diagnosis_priority: initial contact position/orientation prediction versus measured approach; root cause not yet proven
contact_phase_requirements.not_authorized: blind directional correction, unlimited one-finger push, relaxed safety limits
